description: A switch that picks one channel out of a polyphonic cable and sends it to a monophonic output

params.text: Moves the selection on one channel, wrapping from the last channel the cable carries back to the first
Moves the selection back one channel, wrapping from the first channel round to the last
Picks a channel at random from those the cable carries
Keeps a random pick from landing on the channel already selected

inputs.text: The polyphonic cable the module picks from; its channel count sets how many channels are on offer
Shifts the selection away from the channel the buttons chose: 10V shifts by the full channel count and negative voltages shift the other way, with the result wrapping around
A trigger here moves the selection on one channel
A trigger here moves the selection back one channel
A trigger here picks a channel at random
A trigger here returns the selection to channel 1

outputs.text: Carries the selected channel as a single monophonic signal, and no channels at all while the polyphonic input has no cable

notes: The ring of lights around the creature shows which channels the cable carries and which one is being sent out.
